story: ADR-065 B1 (#503): freeze the phase-1 baseline and fairness ceilings

baseline.label: hf2q main with mlx-native 0.15.18 (RoPE partial-rotary fix; phase-1 default)
notes: Operator decision 2026-11-04: B1 baselines the fixed engine, hf2q main once mlx-native 0.15.18 (RoPE partial-rotary fix in rope_multi.metal, affecting Qwen3.6/3.8) is published and pinned on main; never the v0.1.29 release.
Finalized 2026-11-04 from the main build of 38eea839 (version output 'hf2q 0.1.29'; mlx-native =0.15.18 pinned by db0e44d1).

Before launch the driver checks the binary's sha256 and size, the build receipt (bound by sha256: source commit, binary sha256 and size, native version and checksum), the mlx-native pin in Cargo.lock at source_commit, and that the binary embeds exactly one mlx-native version, equal to native.version.

workloads.n1_control: for a change that should not engage with one agent, the n1 interval must lie within +-2.5 points

arms.B: the candidate: the same binary with one kill switch changed

design.block: one block is one paired A and B run; odd blocks run A then B and even blocks B then A, so each pair of consecutive blocks forms ABBA
design.warmup: one discarded run per arm per stage per driver session, in the next block's order

ab_block_count.rule: a count other than 6 is chosen from a separately labelled pilot campaign before qualification; pilot runs are never pooled; no sequential peeking

design.effect: paired log-makespan Student-t 95% interval over quality-eligible blocks (both runs Pass), as a percentage-point reduction of B against A
design.failed_runs: task, tool, protocol, isolation or truncation failures make a run quality-ineligible; every run is retained in the receipt

fairness.paired_regression: per workload, Q3's paired fairness test: block-paired ln(B/A) of the run's worst-slot p95 semantic TTFT and of its worst-slot maximum semantic SSE gap (Student-t 95% interval); a candidate fails if the ratio interval's lower bound exceeds neutral_ratio (reliably worse beyond the band). A measurable metric without an interval is Unverifiable and fails; a metric no passing run measured (one semantic event per streamed turn) does not gate.
fairness.safety_cap: every measured candidate run and slot: p95 semantic TTFT, and the run's maximum semantic SSE gap, at or below cap_factor x the frozen baseline ceiling of its family and workload
fairness.decision: operator decision 2026-11-03 (ReviewB1 finding 3); ADR-065 amendment drafted in docs/research/adr065-b1-campaign.md

baseline_campaign.ceiling: the largest value over the stage's eligible measured runs (outcome Pass, Q5 verdict CalibrationPass, no serious or critical thermal state) and their slots; warmups never count; excluded runs are listed; a stage without an eligible run has no ceiling and is refused

budget.rule: a campaign halts for good once its attempts reach planned runs + retry_allowance_attempts; hours = runs x (run_seconds_estimate + cooldown_seconds)

execution.host: reserved exclusively under HOST-LOCK; no peer or other hf2q process loaded; one engine at a time
execution.q5: every run is one q5_calibration.py supervised runtime and must reach CalibrationPass
execution.thermal: a serious or critical thermal state invalidates the run for acceptance
execution.identities: binary, model, case, harness, Python and host are frozen at campaign start and re-checked before every run; drift halts the campaign for good
